name: getBalance
title: Get Balance
description: Get the CVM coin balance of an account (in copper, 1 CVM = 1,000,000,000 copper), or a fungible token balance if 'token' is given. Defaults to the configured account if 'address' is omitted.

address.description: Account address to check, e.g. '#13'. Defaults to the configured account.

token.description: Optional fungible token actor address, e.g. '#1234'. If given, returns the token balance instead of the coin balance.

balance.description: Balance in copper (or token units if 'token' was given)

token.description: Token actor address, if a token balance was queried
